function: system: AirComp federated learning over scalar single-antenna device-to-server channels, no RIS (p. 5, 10).
notes: Excluded by system (check 6). The work is area 7: p. 5 "AirComp is employed to efficiently aggregate the heterogeneous-width local models" (slimmable FL, width-aware weighting, block-wise AirComp). But the link is scalar: p. 5 "The complex channel coefficient between device k and the ES on width block j is denoted by htk,j" (in C), with scalar channel inversion (Eq. 10); p. 10 channel is path loss times "small-scale Rician fading". The 17 pages never mention antennas, MIMO, RIS or beamforming. Reviewer may prefer above_phy instead, since the learned width allocation is a UCB bandit under energy constraints (p. 9). Quantitative results exist (Tables II-V). The file is the accepted manuscript, whose header prints the DOI.
